name: Satellite for Earth Observation (SEO)
location_str: LC-9 @ Taiyuan Satellite Launch Center, CHN
slot_a_text: Satellite for Earth Observation (SEO) is an Earth observation satellite project of the United Arab Emirates (UAE) by the National Space Science and Technology Center (NSSTC) at the United Arab Emirates University.   The SEO mission aims to develop advanced space technologies and represents an ambitious step toward utilizing space technologies to support sustainability and future development, including giving Emirati talent hands-on experiences in various stages of satellite development and operations including ground station facilities, assembly, integration, and testing (AIT) capabilities.
slot_b_text: China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation's 41st launch of the year, 611th all time. 2nd from LC-9 this year, 144 days since the last one. The 195th orbital launch attempt worldwide this year. Long March 2C is on a 44 flight success streak.
